## Tier header

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| **Tier** | **T4** |
| **Why** | New coach-scoped read routes expose other users' payment rows (client names, amounts, refund/dispute/dunning state) and present fee math (price - processing - TGP 2% = net) to coaches; the Connect status refresh writes the ConnectAccount mirror from Stripe. A tenancy slip or wrong net would show one coach another coach's clients or a false payout figure. |
| **T4 trigger scan** | Tenancy/ownership: YES (every query scoped by `req.user.id` as seller `coach_user_id` or ledger `payee_user_id`; foreign ids are 404). Payments/fee math (reporting only, no money moves): YES. Auth: one new `@Public()` route pair that reads and echoes nothing (Stripe onboarding HTTPS landing). No migration, no schema change, no env name added, no CI gate file touched. |
| **T3 trigger scan** | Public API shape: additive fields on `GET /coach/connect/status` (`state`, `details_submitted`, `disabled_reason`, `action_required`, `requirements{currently_due,past_due,eventually_due,pending_verification,current_deadline}`); legacy `requirements_due` unchanged. Connect onboarding state: `POST /coach/connect/status/refresh` re-reads Stripe via the existing `ConnectService.syncFromStripe`. |
| **Bounded T1** | NO: tenancy + money reporting. |
| **Builder-owner** | Lane S-COACH (agent 111). |
| **Acceptance evidence** | `test/coach-money.service.spec.ts` (23 tests: ledger fold for legacy destination and #627-style four-slice charges, reversals counted once, head-coach split and income, window validation codes, summary + compare + change, recurring MRR/paying/churn/new, charge filters, no Stripe secrets selected, foreign charge 404, attention items with dunning attempt n of 4 / next retry / card-update link sent, disputes, Stripe requirements, connect state derivation, refresh truthfulness, public landing echoes nothing). Updated `test/coach-connect.service.spec.ts`, `test/talent-marketplace-connect-adapter.service.spec.ts` for the additive status fields. Route gates: `test/roles-enforced.spec.ts`, `test/dunning-v2-lockout-allowlist-route-table.spec.ts`, `test/openapi-spec.spec.ts`, `test/route-doc-drift.spec.ts` pass locally. Customer outcome: the coach Money page (mobile S-COACH PR) shows only live numbers. |
| **Promotion triggers** | Already T4. |

## What this adds

### `GET /api/v1/coach/money/summary?from&to[&compare_from&compare_to]`
Net to the coach for a window the device computes in the coach's own time zone (Today / 30d / 90d / YTD), plus the comparison window. Bounded to 400 days; bad windows are `400 MONEY_WINDOW_INVALID` / `MONEY_COMPARE_WINDOW_INVALID`.
- `totals` / `compare_totals`: `gross_cents`, `processing_cents`, `platform_fee_cents`, `head_coach_split_cents`, `refunded_cents`, `head_coach_income_cents`, `net_cents`, `charge_count`, `processing_paid_by` (`coach | platform | mixed | none`).
- Source: split-ledger slices (`destination`, `application_fee`, `head_coach_split`, and `stripe_fee` which only the #627 settlement writes), status posted/reversed, windowed by `posted_at` (fallback `created_at`). Each slice counts `amount - reversed` once. Before #627 the platform pays Stripe's fee on a destination charge, so such charges report processing 0 with `processing_paid_by: 'platform'` rather than an estimate. When #627 lands, the same route reports the actual Stripe fee with no code change here.
- `change_cents`, `change_pct` (null when the previous net is 0).
- `recurring`: `mrr_cents` (active paid recurring, yearly / 12), `paying_clients` (distinct clients with an active paid purchase), `churned_30d` (canceled in 30 days and not still paying), `new_clients_30d` (first paid purchase with this coach in 30 days). $0 grants (`source` set) and $0 packages are excluded everywhere.
- `attention_count`.

### `GET /api/v1/coach/money/charges?status=all|paid|failed|refunded&cursor&limit`
The coach's own paid-package charges, newest first, cursor-paginated (max 50). Each row: client `{id, name}`, package `{id, name}`, amount, billing type, coach-facing `state` (`paid | failed | refunded | partially_refunded | disputed | pending | canceled`), refunded cents. Uses an explicit `select`: no `stripe_client_secret`, `stripe_ephemeral_key` or other Stripe ids leave the server (see gap G-1 below for the older route that does leak them).

### `GET /api/v1/coach/money/charges/:id`
`price - processing - TGP 2% (- head-coach share) = net` for one charge, from the same ledger fold; `settled: false` (and the listed price) until the ledger has the charge. Another coach's id is `404 MONEY_CHARGE_NOT_FOUND`.

### `GET /api/v1/coach/money/attention`
Failed payments with dunning status (attempt n of 4 from the v2 cadence, next retry, lockout time, when the card-update link was last sent, last failure reason), open disputes (status, reason, evidence due), and Stripe requirements due now (`currently_due` / `past_due`, deadline, disabled reason). Each client item carries the client id and name so the app can open "Message client".

### Connect onboarding truth
- `GET /coach/connect/status` gains `state` (`not_started | details_needed | pending_verification | restricted | active | deauthorized`), `details_submitted`, `disabled_reason`, `action_required` and split `requirements` buckets with the deadline. `charges_enabled` / `payouts_enabled` read false once the account is deauthorized.
- `POST /coach/connect/status/refresh` (12/min): re-reads the account from Stripe and returns the status plus `refreshed` (false when Stripe did not answer or Stripe is not configured, so the app can say the status may be a few seconds old).
- `GET /api/v1/connect/onboarding/return` and `/refresh` (`@Public()`): HTTPS landings that 302 to `tgp://connect/onboarding/return|refresh` with a no-store plain page and an "Open The Growth Project" button. They read and echo nothing.

## Operator actions (after merge + deploy; owner/operator only)
1. Set `STRIPE_CONNECT_RETURN_URL=https://backend-spring-lake-3890.fly.dev/api/v1/connect/onboarding/return` and `STRIPE_CONNECT_REFRESH_URL=https://backend-spring-lake-3890.fly.dev/api/v1/connect/onboarding/refresh` (both already registered in `ENV_RULES`; CI env validation lists them as missing feature-tier vars, so onboarding-link returns 503 until set). The README/.env.example/docs examples previously used `growthproject://`, which is not a scheme the app registers.
2. Stripe Branding for the hosted onboarding page (OR-110-2): Dashboard > Settings > Connect > Branding (icon, brand color, accent color).

## Gaps found during recon (not fixed here)
- **G-1 (security, T4, recommend a separate PR):** `GET /v1/coach/payments/purchases`, `/purchases/:id` and `/failed` return raw `ClientPurchase` rows, including `stripe_client_secret` and `stripe_ephemeral_key` of the client's PaymentIntent, to the coach. The new Money routes do not use them. Fix = explicit `select` on those three handlers.
- G-2: on main the split ledger is unique per (purchase, kind, payee), so legacy recurring renewals are not separate ledger rows; #627 changes the key to include the charge. The Money net is ledger-true either way and picks up per-renewal rows when #627 merges.

## Tests (local, through ops/heavy.sh)
- `npx jest test/coach-money.service.spec.ts test/coach-connect.service.spec.ts test/talent-marketplace-connect-adapter.service.spec.ts test/roles-enforced.spec.ts test/dunning-v2-lockout-allowlist-route-table.spec.ts test/route-doc-drift.spec.ts test/openapi-spec.spec.ts test/env-validation.spec.ts test/connect-env-gate.spec.ts test/connect.service.spec.ts --runInBand`: all pass.
- `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json`: clean after the spec fixture update.
- `node scripts/check-r75.js --mode=range`: OK, no banned cast change.
